Subject: Clarification of Routine Process and Invitation for Questions

Dear Team,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to clarify the routine process for submitting expense reports. To ensure that everyone is on the same page, please follow the steps below:

1. Complete the expense report form in full, including all required fields and attaching any necessary receipts or documentation.
2. Submit the completed form and attachments via the designated online portal by the 15th of each month.
3. Once submitted, your manager will review the report and provide any necessary feedback or corrections within one business day.
4. Upon final approval, the finance department will process the reimbursement within three business days.

Please note that late submissions or incomplete forms may cause delays in processing. If you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to reach out to me
